## Summary
- add SEPO_COMMENTS_PREVIEW_SWITCHER=hover as the template-side opt-in for the comment-api main-site bot switcher
- forward data-preview-switcher through the comments config element and sepo.js loader
- document that omitting the env keeps the main-site branch switcher disabled

Requires self-evolving/comment-api#37 for the sepo.js runtime behavior.

## Validation
- npx tsc --noEmit
- npx prettier README.md quartz.ts quartz/components/Comments.tsx quartz/components/scripts/comments.inline.ts --check
- npx tsx --test quartz/util/sepoComments.test.ts quartz/components/scripts/search.test.ts quartz/util/path.test.ts quartz/util/fileTrie.test.ts
- npm run build
- SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO=self-evolving/repo-discussions SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO_ID=R_kgDOSjgnjQ SEPO_COMMENTS_CATEGORY=General SEPO_COMMENTS_CATEGORY_ID=DIC_kwDOSjgnjc4C9gaF SEPO_COMMENTS_PREVIEW_SWITCHER=hover npm run build

Note: full npm test currently includes unrelated .agent tests that fail because local generated script/dist fixtures are absent (e.g. scripts/resolve-scheduled-activity-gate.sh, dist/cli/session-restore.js).
